name: Regent Santa Monica Beach
insider_take: This oceanfront sanctuary sits directly on the legendary Santa Monica Beach, where Hollywood glamour meets California cool in one of the most coveted beach locations on the West Coast.
whats_special: The Regent Santa Monica Beach occupies a prime beachfront position where you can step directly from the lobby onto the famous Santa Monica sand. The hotel sits just steps from the iconic Santa Monica Pier, home to the historic carousel featured in countless movies, and the bustling Third Street Promenade. This is one of the few luxury hotels in LA with direct beach access.
pro_tip: Book a sunset dinner on the hotel's oceanfront terrace during golden hour (around 6-7 PM) for Instagram-worthy shots with the Santa Monica Pier's Ferris wheel glowing in the background.
dont_miss: Take the hotel's complimentary beach service to secure prime sand real estate, then catch the famous Santa Monica sunset from the beach before exploring the pier's amusements. The nearby Venice Beach boardwalk and Muscle Beach are just a 10-minute bike ride south for quintessential LA people-watching.
pros: Unrivaled beachfront location steps from the iconic Santa Monica Pier and Pacific Ocean
Ultra-luxurious rooms and suites featuring stunning ocean and city views
World-class dining experiences with locally inspired, chef-driven cuisine
Exceptional full-service spa and wellness offerings with curated treatments
Impeccable white-glove service rooted in Regent's legendary hospitality standards
cons: Ultra-luxury price point may not suit all budgets
High-demand destination means advance booking is strongly recommended
Bustling beachside location may feel lively for guests seeking a secluded retreat
